items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I was working with him in New York City and I even asked him, I said, “Eddie I have a job, would you like to come out and play” and I called him up and he said sure he would.

ctx.x: Tell me a little bit about your experience with Eddie Condon.

Well I didn’t know him very well but he was a very close friend of my father’s Eddie was. And I knew Eddie later on in life, just before he passed away. And I just started to work with him just before his death. I was working maybe a year or two before. I was working with him in New York City and I even asked him, I said, “Eddie I have a job, would you like to come out and play” and I called him up and he said sure he would. And we were all on cloud nine because Eddie Condon’s going to come out and play with us.…
And didn’t you go on to play in Condon’s?
